name: Higan no Shigan
source:
Main character starts to see light and dark shadows behind various people. He starts to meet new acquaintances and old friends who see a different world in their dreams with forest environment and hidden memories. Protagonist needs to approach this mystery by treating each such person's dreams.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公开始在人们身后看见或明或暗的影子。他陆续遇见新的相识与昔日友人，这些人会在梦中看见一个完全不同的世界，那里有森林般的环境和被隐藏的记忆。主人公必须进入并治疗每个人的梦境，逐步接近谜团真相。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
